channel.title: FXX
channel.description: Notes on business, life, occasional code, and things that catch my interest.

item.title: Is Going All-In a Kind of Wisdom?
item.description: Online, people love to argue that going all-in is a kind of wisdom. Yet when you look away from the screen, everyone around you budgets carefully. Why?

item.title: A New iPhone
item.description: You unbox the latest top-spec iPhone, and before the excitement even wears off, a thought creeps in: why does this feel almost identical to my last one?

item.title: People Living Their Lives
item.description: For decades, people in China brushed questions aside with “not bad.” Lately at the dinner table, more and more sigh that breaking even is enough. What changed?
